_about: Approximate 6-max No-Limit Hold'em, 100bb, 2.5bb opens (SB 3bb), raise-first-in (RFI) ranges. Hand-built to match the shape and width of published solver outputs; NOT exact solver exports. Mixed-frequency hands are rounded to pure. Replace with your own solver exports for production.

three_bet_linear_vs_early._note: vs UTG/HJ opens: mostly linear value + some suited-wheel-ace bluffs

three_bet_polar_vs_late._note: vs CO/BTN opens from blinds or BTN: value + suited blockers/playable bluffs

bb_defend_vs_btn_2_5x_call._note: Approximate flat-call range; BB defends ~60%+ total vs a BTN min-ish open because it closes the action and gets ~3.3:1
